scope: Expanded manually wired numerical gameplay, transport presentation, local social state, time/light and visual animation kernels. The original camera, input-to-movement, player/NPC displacement and yaw chain remains native. Mouth-state recurrence and its visibility threshold are restored to native FP64. Host retains rendering/assets, browser lifecycle, ownership/permissions, path search, unconverted control flow, transcendental inputs, FP64 recurrent state and explicitly counted compatibility/boundary decisions. This is not whole-game neural conversion.

coverage.retainedNativeReason: Original FP64 NPC movement/yaw, player displacement, joystick mapping, movement direction and their upstream camera transforms preserve exact/near-antipodal turn direction. Earlier FP32 actor trajectories could choose the opposite half-turn despite tiny position differences.
coverage.note: Graph and source-region counts are not whole-game conversion percentages. Native repairs, selectors, factories, telemetry and actual tensor execution remain separately observable.
